program:
app "Umrah fund" coin mint
table dep amount money
setting goal money = 500000
let have = sum(dep.amount all)
let p = clamp(have / goal, 0, 1)
row gap 3
  draw 40, 120 width 56
    rect 14, 6, 12, 90 stroke ink thick 2 radius 6
    circle 20, 104, 12 fill red
    rect 16, 100 - 92 * p, 8, 4 + 92 * p fill red
  stack grow gap 1
    have big
    "of" goal faint tap edit goal
    round(p * 100) "% saved" bold
quick dep, amount, [5000, 10000, 25000]
form dep
list dep by day
describe:
Umrah fund, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- dep: amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: goal: money, starts at 500000.
Works out:
- have is the total amount of dep.
- p is have divided by goal kept between 0 and 1.
Shows:
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- text: have.
- text: "of", goal; a tap opens goal for editing.
- text: p times 100 rounded, "% saved".
- one-tap buttons that add a dep with amount set to each of 5000, 10000, 25000.
- a form to add a dep.
- a list of dep by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Mobile shop" phone plum
table accessory name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?
state q text = ""
let short = count(accessory, it.qty <= it.low)
short "accessories running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each accessory where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(accessory, it.qty * it.price) faint
form accessory
remind "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Mobile shop, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- accessory: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; price: money, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the accessory have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "accessories running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each accessory where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the accessory for editing; a swipe removes the accessory, with undo:
    - text: the name of the accessory.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the accessory.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the accessory.
- a form to add a accessory.
Reminder "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Darts" target mint
table point team pick Mum|Dad, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Mum)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
setting winat num = 301 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Mum" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Mum, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Mum, pts = 5
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 5
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Mum win!" head color good
if b >= winat

- b is the total pts of point where team is Dad.

- text: "Mum".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Mum, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Mum, pts set to 5.
- text: "Dad".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 5.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.

- if b is at least winat:

program:
app "Trade profit" chart slate
setting fee num = 0.15 "Brokerage %"
state buy num = 100
state qty num = 100
state sell num = 110
field buy "Buy price"
field qty "Shares"
field sell "Sell price"
let cost = buy * qty * (1 + fee / 100)
let got = sell * qty * (1 - fee / 100)
"Net profit" round(got - cost) big color if(got >= cost, good, bad)
round((got - cost) / max(cost, 1) * 1000) / 10 "%" faint
describe:
Trade profit, in the slate colours.
You can change: "Brokerage %": number, starts at 0.15.
Works out:
- cost is buy times qty times the result of 1 plus fee divided by 100.
- got is sell times qty times the result of 1 minus fee divided by 100.
Remembers while you use it: buy, starting at 100; qty, starting at 100; sell, starting at 110.
Shows:
- a box to fill in buy, labelled "Buy price".
- a box to fill in qty, labelled "Shares".

program:
app "Daily Appliances" home slate
table appliance name text, bought date, warranty_end date, serviced date?, tech_phone text?, repair_cost money?
let soon = count(appliance where warranty_end >= today and warranty_end <= today + 30)
soon "warranties ending within 30 days" head color if(soon > 0, warn, ink)
when soon > 0 notify soon "warranty ending within 30 days"
each appliance sort warranty_end as a
  row card tap edit a swipe remove a
    stack grow
      a.name bold
      "Warranty until" a.warranty_end color if(a.warranty_end - today <= 30, warn, muted)
      "Last service" a.serviced ", repairs" a.repair_cost ", technician" a.tech_phone faint
form appliance
describe:
Daily Appliances, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- appliance: name: text; bought: date; warranty end: date; serviced: date, optional; tech phone: text, optional; repair cost: money, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- soon is how many appliance entries where warranty end is at least today and warranty end is at most today plus 30.
Shows:
- text: soon, "warranties ending within 30 days".
- when soon is more than 0, it shows the notice soon, "warranty ending within 30 days".
- for each appliance sorted by warranty end:
  - a group; a tap opens the appliance for editing; a swipe removes the appliance, with undo:
    - text: the name of the appliance.
    - text: "Warranty until", the warranty end of the appliance.
    - text: "Last service", the serviced of the appliance, ", repairs", the repair cost of the appliance, ", technician", the tech phone of the appliance.
- a form to add a appliance.

fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Aid families" heart mint
table family head_name text, members num 1..20, village text?
table pack family ref family, what pick Ration|Medicine|Clothes|Cash = Ration
count(family, due(it.pack, 30)) "families without help for 30 days" big
each family sort since(it.pack) desc as f empty "No families yet"
  stack card gap 1 tap edit f
    row
      f.head_name bold grow
      f.village faint
    if due(f.pack, 30)
      "Needs a visit" small color warn
    row gap 1
      each options pack.what as w
        button w tap add pack family = f, what = w
form family, "Add family"
describe:
Aid families, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- family: head name: text; members: number, 1 to 20; village: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- pack: family: a family; what: one of Ration, Medicine, Clothes, Cash, starts at Ration. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many of the family have its pack entries is due: never done, or 30 days or more since the last, "families without help for 30 days".
- for each family sorted by days since the last of its pack entries, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the family for editing:
    - text: the head name of the family.
    - text: the village of the family.
    - if the family's pack entries is due: never done, or 30 days or more since the last:
      - text: "Needs a visit".
    - for each choice of the what of the pack:
      - a button the choice; a tap adds a pack with family set to the family, what set to the choice.
- a form to add a family.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one
